body: Orchestrator review of PR #366 (dotfiles-T128-validator-offline-a01, head 39c186ad on base 59599783), read from the fetched head: the Makefile gains one recursively expanded variable UV_PYYAML whose $(if $(shell …)) probe (uv run --offline --with pyyaml python -c 'import yaml') picks the cached form when the cache holds PyYAML and today's index form otherwise, with a one-line comment, and the validate-agent-assets and render-check recipes run $(UV_PYYAML) <script>; nothing else in the Makefile changes; tests/unit/test_makefile_offline.py (new, standard library) holds the two named tests, the second with the stub uv first on PATH recording its argv (probe 0 → the offline form; probe 1 → the index form without --offline; a run exit 1 → one call, no retry, make exit non-zero); 7 changed lines outside tests and .orchestration, 61 added under tests; the worker ran both make targets inside the Claude sandbox from its seat with exit 0 (D10 from a worker seat); the Bot's single review produced no review object, its @codex review answer came as the issue comment "no findings"; no finding.
